naslov: AI Wars Ep. 19: Anthropic IPO hits $1.5T as Google drops Gemini 4 Neon
opis:
Anthropic priced its IPO at $83 per share, above the $70 to $78 range, for a reported valuation of around $1.5 trillion, with trading starting today on Nasdaq under the ticker ANT. Big tech is buying $26 billion in non-voting shares, and TSMC approved up to $500 million each for Anthropic and OpenAI. Meanwhile, Google released Gemini 4 Neon, its fourth new Gemini model in a month, which Google says ranks first on the Artificial Analysis leaderboard for coding agents.

naslov: Snapchat Easy Lens CLI: build AR filters with Claude Code and Cursor | AI Tool #24
opis:
Build AR filters (Lenses) for Snapchat with Claude Code, Cursor or Codex. You describe the filter in words, and the assistant builds it, tests it and sends it to your phone.

How to try it:
1. You need a Mac, Windows or Linux machine and Claude Code, Cursor or Codex
2. Install Easy Lens CLI following the guide on newsroom.snap.com (check the link for the commands)
3. In Claude Code, describe a filter, for example "a café logo falling like snow", and preview it on your phone
4. If you want to earn money from filters, sign up for the Lens+ Payouts program

Price: check the link

naslov: What is multimodal AI? Explained in 30 seconds
opis:
Multimodal AI is an AI model that can understand more than one kind of input, like text, images, audio and video, instead of just typed words. Example: Google's new Gemini 4 Neon accepts text, images, video, audio and PDFs, all in one model.
